consumes.A: INTERFACE_A.json A.1 @b9eb6929: metadata.candidate_receipt (schema i6n.candidate_receipt.v1), one per (candidate, fold); rows per head x split with sums+counts+naive
consumes.B: calls the publisher API below when a candidate reaches a terminal disposition (COMPLETE or not); B's scheduler is not modified by D
consumes.E: genotype/effective config and their canonical sha256 (genotype_canonical_sha256, effective_config_sha256)

record_candidate.effect: validates, builds canonical body bytes (content-addressed), writes one outbox item; state LOCAL_COMPLETE. Idempotent: same body -> same item_id, no new row. Never trains, never touches the scheduler.

returns.states: {LOCAL_COMPLETE, OBJECT_DURABLE, CHAIN_FINALIZED, OLAP_READBACK_VERIFIED} each null or an evidence object

publisher_api.pump: publisher.pump(store, submitter) -> dict: for LOCAL_COMPLETE items PUT body+manifest, GET exact bytes, compare digest -> OBJECT_DURABLE; only then submits the reference transaction. A failed PUT/GET leaves the item LOCAL_COMPLETE and submits nothing (retryable).
publisher_api.etl: tools.i6n_archive.etl.ArchiveETL(outbox, stores, sink, confirmation_depth).run(chain_blocks) -> dict: verifies chain links, finality, reference tx id binding, bytes, digests, schema; projects into the warehouse; reads back; then marks CHAIN_FINALIZED and OLAP_READBACK_VERIFIED (ACK). Reorg: canonical projection revoked by an appended event, history kept.
publisher_api.status: publisher.status() -> {items, per_state_counts, green (all four states), missing: [...]} ; read-only

required.search_candidate_sha256: sha256: B/E global identity of (plan, horizon, canonical genotype); fold-independent
required.plan_sha256: sha256 of the versioned plan JSON (E)
required.effective_config_sha256: sha256 of canonical effective_config (verified by D)
required.fitness: number for COMPLETE/ADOPTED_CACHE only; null otherwise (never an invented score)
required.attempts: [{fold:str, index:1..3, state:str, parent_status_sha256:sha256|null, fencing_token:str|null, reason:str|null}] (max 3 per fold)
required.costs: object of finite numbers or null (elapsed_seconds, fit_seconds, peak_rss_bytes, ...)

fold_receipt: A's candidate_receipt (i6n.candidate_receipt.v1) unchanged; rows with split TEST or a 2025+ fold are refused

derived_metrics_per_receipt_row.skill_mae: RATIO (only when naive_mae>0; undefined otherwise, never zero)

projection.idempotency_key: sha256(canonical(row identity with derived metric/unit)) + block_hash + finality_state
projection.warehouse: gov_report/gov_metric (one report per receipt row; gov_metric.horizon = head_offset_hours) + additive gov_doin_projection, gov_doin_projection_event, view gov_doin_metric_canonical (doin metadata schema i6n.doin_projection.v1)

archive.body: doin.external_payload_body.v1 (doin-core doin_core.archive.external): canonical UTF-8 JSON {schema, domain_id, producer_peer_id, payload_schema, payload}; contains no manifest digest and no block hash
archive.manifest: doin.external_payload_manifest.v1: {schema, body_digest, body_size, body_schema, payload_schema, domain_id}
archive.reference_tx: CANDIDATE_EVALUATED transaction payload doin.external_payload_ref.v1 {archive_mode, body_digest, manifest_digest, body_size, payload_schema, locator} (external) or the same plus body (full_payload); tx.id must equal compute_id
archive.hash_identities: body_digest = sha256(body bytes); manifest_digest = sha256(manifest bytes); block hash = header hash. Three distinct values, none an input of its own computation.

state_rule: each state is set only by the step that verified it; a missing state is never reported green
